judge_edits.from: الفریج نامی روایتی محلہ بلدیہ کے قلعے کے اندر
judge_edits.to: بلدیہ کے قلعے کے اندر واقع الفریج نامی روایتی محلہ
judge_edits.why: Reader P1: without the comma «روایتی محلہ بلدیہ» ran together as one compound «Mohalla Baladia». The fort phrase now comes first and «واقع» joins it to the noun as a participle («… کے اندر واقع X»), so «بلدیہ» opens the line and never follows «محلہ». The place-first remedy is the rider of the termbase (place before the name); «الفریج نامی روایتی محلہ» is kept whole, as calibration point (2) writes it.

rulings.text: The one venue is said place first: «بلدیہ کے قلعے کے اندر واقع الفریج نامی روایتی محلہ». The fort phrase in the oblique with «کے اندر», then «واقع», then the published name phrase «الفریج نامی روایتی محلہ» unchanged. A name of a quarter is not set directly after «محلہ» + another noun with no comma; where the relation removes a comma, the container goes first.

blind_disposition.disposition: Goal met: one place, the quarter nested inside the fort.
Accepted and fixed by the judge: fort phrase first, joined with «واقع»; the two nouns no longer touch.

source_defect. Source defect recorded in tr-events-1: the English name «Municipality Fort» does not say what the place is; both names are kept exactly as the published value writes them. Not this batch.
Out of scope: calibration ruling P1 writes the place name as Arabic writes it, with its article.
Rejected: the «X نامی» form is calibration point (2) for a name met in passing; kept.
Out of scope: a text-cut artefact of the card layout, not the place line.
